description: This PHP source file 'reqEdit.php' appears to be part of the TestLink open source testing management tool. It handles viewing and editing requirements within a requirements specification, including initializing page parameters, rendering the GUI, and managing user permissions. It interacts with multiple external dependencies, templates, and configurations related to requirement management and web editing.
